Specification: This module defines a simulation wrapper around a Knuth-Yao coin-flipping specification, using TLC generation mode to collect statistical data about the outcomes of the algorithm. It models both a stateless crooked coin and a stateful crooked coin, initializes a simulation state, advances the system by taking transitions according to the current flip, and records completed samples into a CSV file while maintaining TLC counters. The specification also includes assumptions about the TLC runtime configuration, a statistics constraint for side effects during generation, and a postcondition that checks the number of generated samples and applies a chi-square test to the observed terminal-state distribution.
AssumptionNames:
/\ TLCGet("config").mode = "generate"
    /\ TLCGet("config").depth >= 15 \/ TLCGet("config").depth = -1
    /\ TLCGet("config").deadlock = FALSE
    /\ TLCGet("revision").timestamp >= 1663720820

/\ CSVRecords(CSVFile) = 0 => CSVWrite("side,p,flip", <<>>, CSVFile)
    /\ \A i \in Done: TLCSet(atoi(i), 0)
IfThenElse: IF RandomElement(1..8) \in 1..3 THEN /\ flip' = "T" ELSE /\ flip' = "H"
IF RandomElement(1..p.den) = 1 THEN flip' = "T" ELSE flip' = "H"
